text: How was your journey? Was it okay? Yeah, it was fine. But I did see something really strange on the way. Yeah? What was that? Well, at about midnight last night, I was driving along next to a field and the road was quite narrow. In front of me, I suddenly saw this huge snake lying across the road. Ah! Really? Yeah! I mean, it was obviously dead, but next to it, I could see what I thought was going on. But next to it, I could see what I thought was a cat eating part of the snake. As I got nearer though, I realised that it was actually the largest, most disgusting rat I have ever seen in my life, staring up at my car. It was so horrible. Actually, I was so shocked I almost ran it over. I just managed to avoid it and it disappeared into the long grass. Oh, nasty!
